source_context.compiler: fixed GCC13.3 O3 static; no PGO on either side
source_context.scope: 3-pair screening, not adoption or official scoring

scope: 96 pairs: 8 switches x4 scenarios x3 seeds x1 pair; 64 queries per phase. Screening only.

I09.reason: Standard Q ratios 0.98139/0.97008; high768_k1 0.97443/0.96720. Mixed k100 gains do not establish general improvement. A one-CPU quota case removed observed throttling, but one pair is mechanism evidence only; no new I09 version requested.

I10.reason: All three sizes lose on standard and large100k in every pre-restart seed. Standard Q ratios 0.68586/0.76416/0.92604; large100k 0.78825/0.75951/0.78348. Keep certified full integer distance. Do not choose a block from a noisy high768 gain.

I12.reason: All three pilot counts lose on standard and large100k in every pre-restart seed. Standard Q ratios 0.91705/0.95864/0.89106; large100k 0.88870/0.86998/0.87019. Added pilot work does not amortize in this screen.

I14.reason: Standard Q 1.00922 spans 0.96335–1.01813; k100 Q 1.06344 spans 1.00402–1.07261. This is a useful output-size hypothesis, not enough to adopt. Root is analyzing the separate completed wide-output job.

interpretation: These are real cgroup-v2 counters, not /proc RSS/IO proxies. memory.peak includes charged group/descendant memory, including page cache; it is not process RSS.
cpu.stat usage/user/system are group CPU microseconds. Quotas 100000/100000 and 200000/100000 permit one/two CPU-equivalents while affinity remains two cores.
io.stat is block-device-accounted group IO, not application logical reads or a general device benchmark. Both sides had byte- and operation-identical IO in all four pairs.
Resources include database launchers, both process starts, shutdown and restart verification; the Python driver is outside. Phase lifecycle sums exclude verification wall time.
2GiB memory and zero swap were diagnostic limits. No memory-limit/OOM events occurred. Three stable IO reads after exit bound the observation, not all possible delayed writeback.
high768_k100 cpu1: baseline had 5 throttled periods/281817us, candidate zero; cpu2 candidate CPU usage increased ~16%. This does not justify enabling I09 by default.

inferences_not_measured: I10 regressions in coded 128d/16d cases are consistent with block-loop/kernel-call overhead exceeding avoided integer work; no per-row kernel counter was measured.
high768 cases exceed the 4MiB code budget at 10000x768, so their I10 gains cannot establish integer early-exit benefit; compiled layout and run noise remain possible.
I12 adds exact pilot work before the existing norm-ordered scan; observed losses do not prove which microarchitectural cost dominates.
Very wide startup/ingest/index/restart ranges show host/order noise. Do not claim lifecycle speedup from unrelated ingest movement or multiply ratios from different workloads.
